parole.testo: Substratum word, perhaps derived from something such as a Dacian *hied-, from Proto-Indo-European *h₁ed- (“to eat”), a term akin to Albanian hamës, or derived from it.

parole.significato: Black nightshade (Solanum nigrum), also known as sunberry.
parole.testo: From Dacian *dierna (“black”), compare prodiarna. Compare also the hydronym Cerna, whose classical name Dierna was modified under the influence of the synonymous Proto-Slavic *čьrnъ.
